thread:
sam: Quick sync — thinking through API key rotation and tenant-scoped routing. How does rotating org/project keys affect pinned model routing, dedicated pools, and fallbacks? Root concern: live clients using pinned model versions suddenly get routed to fallback when key rotates.

ara: Good question. TL;DR: rotation can affect routing if key <-> tenant mapping changes or if we rely on key to lookup pin config. We currently use `X-Api-Key` for auth and `x-tenant-id` header for tenant scoping.

mike: Security: rotating keys must be atomic from control plane perspective. We need short-lived tokens or key versions. Propose `X-Api-Key-Version: v2` header and silent dual-key acceptance for 5m.

jess: Ops: for Dedicated, we pin capacity by tenant id, not key. But internal routing table ties tenant->project->pinned model, which is cached on routers. Cache invalidation on rotation is the tricky bit.

sam: Example flow: client rotates key => control plane updates mapping => routers must refresh mapping without dropping in-flight requests. Any ideas for rollout strategy? :thinking_face: 

ara: We can do staged rollout: accept old and new keys for N minutes, update mapping, emit `tenant_mapping.changed` event, streaming agents pick it up. Also increment key `version` in metadata.

mike: On rotation impact to tool-calling: tokens used in function calls often stored in KV. If we rotate, we must re-encrypt or rebind secrets. Add migration plan in launch criteria.

jess: For Dedicated Envs, schedule canary for mapping refresh on 10% of routers, check 1) no 401 spike 2) latency stable 3) correct model variant routed.

sam: Launch checklist proposal: 1) dual-key acceptance window configurable; 2) tenant mapping event + idempotent handler; 3) router cache TTL <= 30s or RT update on event; 4) observability: per-route auth failures; 5) docs for customers about client-side key swap.

ara: Add: support for project-scope keys and org-scope keys. Project keys auto-inherit project routing; org keys need explicit project param to avoid ambiguous mapping.

mike: Must ensure rotation doesn't allow privilege escalation: keys must include scope claim `{"scope":"project","project_id":"xyz"}` and we validate.

jess: Ops note: for private (VPC) deployment, key rotation through CI/CD or KMS rotation might be used; we need an API to push new key metadata.

sam: Action items: @ara to draft API proto for `POST /v1/keys/rotate` + schema, @jess to run cluster-level canary plan, @mike to write threat model tweaks. Sync Fri 2pm.

deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled: Product/Eng auth sync — Fri 14:00. Invite sent to sam, ara, jess, mike.

sam: ack. I'll add this to roadmap PR with priority P1 for Dedicated/Private launch.
